verdicts.CRITICAL: Multiple strong scam-pattern signals detected. Pause and do not act yet.
verdicts.HIGH: High risk signals detected. Avoid clicking links, sharing codes, or sending money.
verdicts.MEDIUM: Some suspicious signals found. Verify independently before taking any action.
verdicts.LOW: No strong scam indicators detected — this is not a guarantee of safety.
verdicts.UNCERTAIN: Insufficient or mixed evidence. Verify through an official channel before acting.

elderly_verdicts.CRITICAL: Warning! This message looks very risky. Do not pay, click, or share any code.
elderly_verdicts.HIGH: Warning! This message may be fake. Someone could be trying to take your money or details.
elderly_verdicts.MEDIUM: Be careful! Some parts of this message look unusual. Ask a family member first.
elderly_verdicts.LOW: No clear warning signs found here, but still be careful with money and OTPs.
elderly_verdicts.UNCERTAIN: Not enough information to be sure. Please ask a family member or check your official app.

intent_labels.OTP: Share an OTP, PIN, CVV, or password
intent_labels.MONEY: Send money, pay a fee, or approve a payment
intent_labels.PERSONAL_INFO: Share Aadhaar, PAN, bank account, or KYC details
intent_labels.APP_INSTALL: Install an app or allow remote screen sharing
intent_labels.LINK_CLICK: Open an external link or join a chat group
intent_labels.CALL_BACK: Call back or continue on a private call

manipulation_descriptions.fear: Uses fear of account closure, disconnection, arrest, or legal trouble.
manipulation_descriptions.urgency: Pressures you with tight deadlines so you act before checking.
manipulation_descriptions.authority: Claims to be a bank, police, CBI, customs, or government body.
manipulation_descriptions.greed: Promises prizes, guaranteed profits, refunds, or easy daily income.
manipulation_descriptions.isolation: Tells you not to inform family or not to disconnect the call.
manipulation_descriptions.false_trust: Uses official-sounding reassurances or promises money will be returned.

category_consequences.digital_arrest: Scammers posing as officials may try to keep you isolated on a call and pressure you into transferring money to a fake 'safe account'.
category_consequences.remote_access: Installing a screen-sharing app lets someone view your OTPs, banking apps, and potentially guide or perform unauthorised actions.
category_consequences.otp_theft: Sharing an OTP, PIN, or CVV can allow immediate unauthorised transactions or account takeover.
category_consequences.kyc_fraud: Fake KYC links often capture netbanking logins, card numbers, or identity documents.
category_consequences.utility_disconnection: Fake disconnection warnings commonly try to rush you into paying a stranger or installing a malicious app.
category_consequences.lottery_prize: Asking for an upfront fee or tax to claim a prize is a classic pattern where money is lost without any real reward.
category_consequences.job_fraud: Jobs requiring upfront registration fees or 'prepaid tasks' often escalate into larger unrecoverable deposits.
category_consequences.investment_fraud: Promises of guaranteed or multiplied returns are frequently used to draw victims into fake trading groups.
category_consequences.delivery_fraud: Fake parcel hold messages use small fees to collect card or UPI details or trick you into larger charges.
category_consequences.payment_refund: Scanning a QR code or entering your UPI PIN sends money out of your account — it is never required to receive money.
category_consequences.banking_fraud: Account-block scares are used to push people toward phishing pages or credential sharing.
category_consequences.other_suspicious: Following unverified urgency requests may expose money, credentials, or personal data.
